needs: commands.test set in .factory/sandbox/manifest.json, so the tests gate runs this repo's tests instead of returning neutral
why: The manifest records commands.test as null and lists 'Automated tests and total coverage' under capabilities.not_exercised, because the repo had no test framework, no test files and no test script. This PR changes that fact: package.json now has a `test` script (`node --test`, node's built-in runner, no new dependency) and src/report.test.js covers src/report.js at 100% of lines. I ran `npm test` here (6 tests, all passing) and `node --test --experimental-test-coverage` to read the coverage, but the gates read commands.test from main's manifest, so `bsf gates tests` will still report no_tests and `bsf gates coverage` will still find no report and return neutral against the 0% floor. Nothing in the sandbox blocked the work; what is missing is the manifest line that lets the gate see it. The manifest is protected, so I have not edited it. Suggested amendment: set commands.test to `npm test`. If the coverage gate should also have teeth, the test script needs to emit coverage/lcov.info (node's `--experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info`) and coverage/ needs a .gitignore entry; I left that out of this PR because it is not part of the work item.
